shortDescription: BlackRock's Head of Emerging Markets Egon Vavrek said AI hardware and the "picks-and-shovels" companies serving hyperscalers will carry emerging markets forward, according to Bloomberg.He made the comments on the sidelines of the BofA APAC Conference in Hong Kong.

title: AI Hardware, Picks-and-Shovels to Drive Emerging Markets: BlackRock's Vavrek
